summary: Both fuel quantities are integers capped at 100, so the complete legal input domain has a fixed bound and cannot support an honest asymptotic scaling experiment for the constant-time arithmetic solution.

replacement_checks.evidence: The closed form performs one subtraction, one integer division, one minimum, one addition, and fixed-factor multiplication regardless of either input value.
Authored cases cover both input maxima, a main tank below the first trigger, the exact first and second trigger thresholds, one liter before the second threshold, and reserve-limited transfers.
